title: Virtual Compute: snapshot allocation — allocated excess
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute snapshot allocation — Allocate the backup entitlement once against the total physical GB-month subtotal and record the excess floored at zero as compute-attributable GB-month, rounded half-up to six decimals only at the final allocation. This replaces charging all physical shared snapshots to compute; it changes the nonfinancial allocation, never the raw meter history.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for snapshot allocation — allocated excess?**

Allocate the backup entitlement once against the total physical GB-month subtotal and record the excess floored at zero as compute-attributable GB-month, rounded half-up to six decimals only at the final allocation. This replaces charging all physical shared snapshots to compute; it changes the nonfinancial allocation, never the raw meter history.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, total physical snapshots are 130 GB-month and backup entitlement is 100 GB-month. The compute-attributable quantity is 30.000000 GB-month. At physical quantities of 100 or 99 GB-month, it is zero. Entitlement is subtracted once from the total.
